overview: A self-sovereign platform for designing and playing your own trading card game online — design cards, build decks, enforce rules, and let anyone play via invite link.
features: Full game rules editor — resource system, card types, win conditions, turn structure, keywords
Structured card ability builder — 8 triggers, 9 targets, 12 effects with live card preview
Deck builder with live analysis — cost curve, type/role distribution, format validation
Rule-enforced online play — only legal moves, auto-resolve abilities, win detection
Private 1v1 via invite link or join code
First-run wizard for new designers — 5-step guided setup
